en.headline: Building repairs bureau to hire about 90 staff initially, Ning says
en.dek: Development Secretary Bernadette Linn said the new non-statutory bureau will start operations by year end and begin services in January, with staff phased in through mid-next year.
body: Development Bureau Secretary Bernadette Linn said on Sunday that the planned Building Maintenance Support and Services Bureau will initially hire about 90 people, including professionals, technical support and administrative staff.

According to Linn, speaking on a television programme, the bureau is expected to begin operations by the end of this year and launch services from January. Staff recruitment is targeted to see personnel take up posts progressively from early next year through mid-year. She described the scale of about 90 as appropriate compared with the roughly 270 staff currently handling related work at the Urban Renewal Authority.

The bureau will provide end-to-end support for owners undertaking building repairs, including inspection consultants, tendering and evaluation, and monitoring of works. Linn noted dual safeguards, with the bureau reviewing consultants' performance and the Buildings Department providing statutory oversight under planned amendments to the Buildings Ordinance requiring inspection reports to be submitted for approval.

Linn also commented on other related measures, including the possible use of a dual-envelope tender system for more complex projects and the rationalisation of land search arrangements under the title registration system, under which media inquiries involving public interest would still be possible on a case-by-case basis.

zh.headline: 樓宇維修支援及服務局初期聘約90人 年底運作
zh.dek: 發展局局長甯漢豪指新局年底前開始運作，明年1月推出服務，人員明年中前陸續就位。
body: 發展局局長甯漢豪周日表示，「樓宇維修支援及服務局」初期將聘用約90人，包括專業人士、技術支援及行政人員等。
甯漢豪在電視節目上說，該局預計年底前開始運作，明年1月起推出服務。招聘目標是由明年初至明年年中陸續就位。她指約90人的規模合適，相比市建局現時約270人負責相關樓宇維修工作。
新局將為業主提供全流程支援，包括驗樓顧問、招標評標及施工監察。甯漢豪提到設有雙重保障，局方檢視顧問表現，屋宇署則根據計劃修訂的《建築物條例》作法定規管，要求驗樓報告交署方審批。
甯漢豪亦談及其他相關措施，包括較複雜項目或採用雙信封制評標，以及土地業權註冊制度下查冊安排的合理化，涉及公眾利益的傳媒查冊仍可逐案處理。
